newsitem.title: USA: US Plains cattle trade slow at $64, up $1-feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains cattle trade slow at $64, up $1-feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle near midday sold at $64.00 per cwt in light volume, up $1.00 from last week, feedlot sources said.
About 2,000 head sold in the Texas Panhandle and western Oklahoma area and about 1,000 in Kansas, sources there said.
However, some bids at $64.00 were passed by other owners pricing cattle at $65.00, they said.
"I think everybody's going to try to sit tight for a little bit to see if packers will come around to $65.00," one Kansas feedlot manager said.
